subject.title: fix(auto-reply): narrow preflight compaction retryability to timeout, 429, and 5xx only

question: Should this external PR require redacted WebChat/Control UI or equivalent live-output proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate based on source and test evidence?
rationale: The code shape matches prior maintainer feedback, but the PR changes runtime failure policy and only provides tests plus a local proof script, not after-fix behavior from a real setup.

options.title: Require Real Behavior Proof
options.body: Keep the narrowed runtime fix but require redacted WebChat/Control UI, terminal/live-output, or log proof for a timeout, 429, or 5xx preflight failure before merge.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate and accept that the real Composer recovery path was not demonstrated.

options.title: Switch To UI Recovery
options.body: If fail-open runtime behavior is not desired, pause this branch and pursue gateway/UI lifecycle recovery for the lockout instead.

recommendation.title: Require Real Behavior Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the narrowed runtime fix but require redacted WebChat/Control UI, terminal/live-output, or log proof for a timeout, 429, or 5xx preflight failure before merge.
